transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been having these thoughts that… it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but the thoughts scared me enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up?
It’s been about four months now, I think. It started around when my aunt came to live with us.
Have you been enjoying the things you usually like to do over the past four months?

No, not really. I used to look forward to doing my watercolors, going to dance class, and walking with the ladies, but lately I just leave my things sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself care about any of it.
Have you felt much pleasure when you did manage to do those things, like watercolors or dancing, over the past four months?

No… even when I try to do them, it doesn’t feel like it used to. I used to really look forward to painting or dance class, but now I mostly just leave everything sitting there. I can’t seem to care enough to enjoy it.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish, or have you noticed any changes in your movement or activity level lately?
Yeah… more sluggish, I guess. My husband says it looks like everything takes extra effort for me now. Even at the market, I’ll just stand there for too long before I can pick up what I came for.
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the past four months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of my weight, and I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Yes… I do. Mostly about my aunt. If I get tired or annoyed with her, I start thinking I’m a bad woman. Like I should be more grateful, and that I’m bringing shame on my family for feeling that way.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I get bothered by things, but I’m not sure I’d call it feeling anxious or on edge.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual or like it's an effort to do physical things?
Yes… I think so. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort now. Even at the market, I’ll just stand there too long before I pick up what I came for.
Have you been feeling fidgety or unable to sit still lately?

Not really fidgety, no. It’s more the opposite… I feel slowed down. My husband says everything I do looks like it takes extra effort, and even at the market I’ll just stand there too long before I pick something up.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
Yes… sometimes. When I get tired or annoyed with my aunt, I start thinking I’m a bad woman. Like I should be more grateful, and that I’m bringing shame on my family.
Have you been having these thoughts of not waking up nearly every day over the past four months?

Yes… pretty much. Not every single day maybe, but very often these past months. I keep thinking it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but the thought is there, and it scared me enough to come in.
Have you been experiencing these feelings of worthlessness or guilt nearly every day over the past four months?

Yes, it’s been happening a lot over these months. When I’m tired, or if I get annoyed with my aunt, I start feeling like I’m a bad woman… like I should be more grateful and I’m bringing shame on my family.
Have you been thinking about death often, beyond just not wanting to wake up?

Not really beyond that… it’s mostly that thought that it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but having that thought so much is what scared me enough to come in.
Have you been feeling like you can't sit still or have you been fidgeting a lot lately?

Not so much fidgeting. It’s more the opposite, I think. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort now, and even at the market I’ll just stand there too long before I pick up what I came for.
Have you been experiencing significant distress or impairment in your social, occupational, or other areas of functioning due to these feelings and thoughts over the past four months?

Yes. I’ve stopped going to my dance class and my walking group, and I don’t do my food-pantry shifts anymore. My husband has had to take over more of the errands too, because I get stuck… I fall behind and things just don’t get done like they used to.
Have you been feeling like you're fidgeting or can't sit still?

No, not really like I can’t sit still. It’s more that I’m slowed down. My husband notices it—he says I move like everything takes extra effort. Even at the market, I’ll just stand there for a while before I can pick what I came for.
Have you experienced a loss of interest in almost all activities for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past four months?

Yes. I used to look forward to my watercolors, and going to dance class, and walking with the ladies. Lately I just leave my paints sitting there, and I don’t feel like going anywhere. I can’t seem to make myself care about those things most days.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks over the past four months where you felt better and your interest in activities returned?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been pretty steady for about four months now, since my aunt came to live with us. I haven’t really had a stretch where I felt back to myself or interested in things again.
